AGCO says key parts shortages in recent weeks had already forced it to cut production and unit shipments while inventory rose (A). If the shortages persist into the next quarter, fewer units available to ship could pull reported sales down at least 5% year on year. The latest sales growth rate is unspecified.

Activision Blizzard's consolidated revenue growth slowed to 6% in Q3 from 17% over nine months (A, E). Stay-at-home orders had lifted game demand by giving players more time to play (C). If that lift fades further against the pandemic-era comparisons, quarterly revenue could cross to -5% within two quarters.
